event.title: Car Bomb in Colombia Injures 11 Ahead of Presidential Inauguration
event.canonical_title: Car Bomb in Colombia Injures 11 Ahead of Presidential Inauguration
event.summary: A car bomb explosion in Colombia has left at least 11 people injured just days before the presidential inauguration of Abelardo de la Espriella. The president-elect condemned the attack, asserting that terrorism will not intimidate the nation and pledging a crackdown on rebel groups and criminal organizations.

key_facts: At least 11 people were injured in a car bomb explosion in Colombia.
The bombing occurred days before the presidential inauguration of Abelardo de la Espriella.
President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella condemned the attack and vowed to combat terrorism.

timeline.title: Bombing Attacks Injure Two Amid De la Espriella's Tough Stance on Violence
timeline.summary: Following his inauguration, President Abelardo de la Espriella is confronted with two bombing incidents in Colombia. The attacks, attributed to FARC dissidents, included an explosion targeting a highway tollbooth near Cali, injuring two individuals, and a separate incident in the northern department of Cesar that resulted in the death of a police officer. De la Espriella had campaigned on a hard-line approach to combat the country's violence.
key_facts: Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in as president.
Two bombing attacks occurred shortly after his inauguration.
One attack targeted a highway tollbooth near Cali, injuring two.
A police officer was killed in a separate attack in Cesar.
FARC dissidents are believed to be responsible for the attacks.
